title: Jasper van Brakel (CEO, RSF Regenerative Social Finance · Aspen Fellow) — 'An important book' on governance and ownership structures that serve human flourishing
summary: Van Brakel is CEO of RSF Regenerative Social Finance, an Aspen Fellow and an economist. He endorsed the book and tagged Purpose Trust, the Ownership Network and the Ownership Capital Lab.
blockquote: As they grow, businesses risk losing their actual mission. The causes are structural rather than incidental. And that means they are fixable. In his recent book #Incorruptible, Eric Ries presents real solutions with business governance and ownership structures that can serve human flourishing rather than just profit maximization. An important book.
